product_metadata.title: 17 inch Clear Plastic Dress Hangers (Case of 20) - Features a Chrome Swivel Hook and Notched Shoulders - Perfect for Lightweight Fabrics and Can Be Used for Retail Stores
features: Case of 20 - Set of 20 premium plastic dress hangers. Durable and strong with a metal swivel hook.
Material and Size - SSW Basics dress hangers are made from high strength plastic and a metal hook. These hangers are 17" long, the standard dress hanger size.
Crystal Clear - Crystal clear style makes the hanger a stylish addition to your closet organization.
Use - Use these hangers for a variety of clothing types from t-shirts to tank tops. SSW Basics hangers are versatile and strong.
Durable - The high-density plastic makes these dress hangers lightweight but also sturdy and durable. A great value for your closet organization.
